I would like to sincerely thank Dr Munazza Ahmad at High Road Surgery, Stuart Crescent, Wood Green for the excellent care she provides.
Dr Ahmad is a wonderful doctor who truly listens to her patients. She takes her time during consultations, pays attention to detail, and makes you feel comfortable and respected. It is clear that she genuinely cares about the wellbeing of the people she treats.
When I asked for a referral, she handled everything professionally and arranged it without delay. Because of her support, I am now being seen by specialists at North Middlesex University Hospital, which I really appreciate.
Dr Ahmad clearly takes her profession to heart. Her kindness, patience, and professionalism make a real difference. Doctors like her remind us how important it is to have compassionate healthcare professionals.
Thank you, Dr Ahmad, for your dedication and for treating your patients with such care and respect.
